description: This file defines the DeadlineClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the AWS Deadline Cloud service. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to AWS Deadline, such as creating, updating, deleting, and listing resources, as well as some role assumptions and batch operations. The class extends AwsClient, indicating it is a client class used to make API calls to the AWS service.

classes.name: DeadlineClient
classes.description: A client class used to interface with AWS Deadline Cloud service, providing methods for managing farms, fleets, jobs, queues, monitors, and other related resources.

methods.name: associateMemberToFarm
methods.description: Associates a member to a farm in AWS Deadline.

methods.name: associateMemberToFarmAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a member to a farm in AWS Deadline.
